fields.direction: resolves part of the card's NFI-029-LOAD-CONTROL
fields.note: Every one of the 14 lead endpoints is a true limit point of the axisymmetric model. Under pole displacement control the pressure peaks and then falls; for 021b W it peaks at 90.736 kPa at pole dz -80.4 mm and falls to 76.53 kPa at -140.4 mm. The card's load-control endpoints are within 0.032% of those maxima. Nonaxisymmetric modes remain unexamined (NFI-029-AXISYMMETRY).

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
